title: You don't need more motivation. You need to start *joymaxxing.*

label: THE PROBLEM
head: You didn't lose your drive. You lost your fun.
sub: Somewhere between 18 and 25, you quietly stopped doing everything that made you feel alive.

label: WHAT REPLACED IT
head: Scroll. Work. Scroll. Sleep.
sub: Every day feels the same because every day IS the same. Your brain is starving for real reward.

head: Joymaxxing also looks like this
cells: Getting rejected and laughing it off
Calling a friend instead of texting
Learning a dumb skill for fun
Doing something that scares you a little

label: THE RULE
head: One real-life fun thing per day
sub: Not a screen. Not productive. Just alive. Your drive comes back on its own.

head: Discipline builds the life. *Joy* makes you want to live it.
